#DelhiPolice has issued a traffic advisory in the national capital regarding the Independence Day Ceremony at Red Fort tomorrow for the convenience of the public and security reasons. 

Several roads will be closed for general traffic from 4.00 AM to 10.00 AM, with only labelled vehicles permitted.

These include – Netaji Subhash Marg, S P Mukherjee Marg, Chandni Chowk road, Esplanade road and ring road from Rajghat to ISBT. 

Delhi Police have also advised the public to avoid C- Hexagon India Gate, Copernicus Marg, Mandi House, A point Tilak Marg and Mathura Road.

data.raw_text:
[6:38PM] #Anthony #TrafficUpdate 

Good movement from Dorman Long bridge to Fadeyi, Onipanu, Palm Grove, Obanikoro, and Anthony. 
Smooth traffic on Anthony inward Idiroko up to Independence Tunnel, Maryland Odo'iyaaloro to New Garage. 
However, slow movement at Ojota down to Ketu/Tsunami Interchange Bridge due to high traffic volume and pedestrians. 
Return journey from Interchange to Ojota is smooth on both service lane and main carriageway. 
No impediments reported, with personnel visible on ground managing traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
